_about: Reading lists entered by hand for hubs whose list the extraction cannot read. Each entry gives its source. Read by make_hubs.py.

scp-anthology-2025.why: The hub draws its list with a script inside an embedded html block (raw_wiki/hubs/scp-anthology-2025.frame1.html); the eleven entries, in the hub's order from Malkuth to Daat, are copied from that script. They are also exactly the pages tagged tree-of-life.
